precedence.rule: For this order-only repair child, this machine-readable contract and the repair release policy override conflicting parent rules. Every parent byte remains immutable historical evidence.

scientific_purpose: Estimate whether correctly aligned synthetic identity-history features add predictive value to a frozen operational English-source baseline on a mechanism-stratified synthetic Chinese case-control task.

models.m0: Frozen LightGBM plus legacy18 plus LaBSE operational English-source pipeline; no synthetic-Chinese fitting.
models.m1: Frozen M0 plus the same 33-feature adapter trained on each of five whole-vector, endpoint-disjoint train derangements within world and C40/complement strata.
models.m2: Frozen M0 plus the same adapter trained on the correctly aligned train identity33 matrix.
models.audit_use: Fixed holdout estimation only; no model, threshold, feature, slice or analysis selection.

truth_and_sampling.c40_design: Oracle-stratified synthetic case-control sampling: positive and negative strata are formed from controller truth, then eight positive mechanisms and seven difficult-negative flags are covered before HMAC fill.
truth_and_sampling.estimand: The preregistered mechanism-stratified synthetic case-control population, not natural underground-market prevalence, calibration or label-blind candidate production.
truth_and_sampling.c40_output_order: Within each world, sort the selected C40 by full HMAC-SHA256(candidate_key, world_uid, selected_global_rank, canonical_pair_uid), then canonical_pair_uid UTF-8; this stream is independent of selection/fill ranking.

shortcut_gate.claim: Passing excludes only a registered 14-feature metadata shortcut above these thresholds; it does not prove absence of unknown shortcuts.

sample_size_design.design: Fixed maximum feasible 500 worlds per split with prospective sensitivity reporting; not selected by a fabricated score-distribution Monte Carlo.

classification_metrics.average_precision: World-equal weighted sklearn average_precision_score staircase integral.
classification_metrics.trapezoidal_pr_auc: Separately named trapezoidal area under the precision-recall curve; never aliased to average precision.
classification_metrics.threshold_source: Each model uses its own development-frozen threshold; Audit A/B never select thresholds.

retrieval_metrics.tie_handling: Deterministic descending float64 score, then gallery seller UID UTF-8 bytes.

repair_lineage.allowed_change: independent selected_global_rank serialization order and order-bound derived files, receipts, and manifests only
